arStrings.szText: "So this is where Akarat's procession went. This place feels wrong."
This is Atanos. The archivists say it was the cradle of humankind. The first city in the world...lost in a great flood.
Somber, pensive. Looking out over silent, accursed ruins.
Myth or not, generations of Amazons lie buried in the mud here. For my Queen to follow Akarat to this place, with our people...
Somber, foreboding, concerned. She's lost many soldiers and friends here.
I need to find her. Let's hurry to Celestia and put this ruin behind us.
Determined. Eager to get out of here.
